name: com.rubickanov.save
description: One store for everything a game keeps of the player's, named by game-declared area and name instead of a path, async for consoles, written whole or not at all: files on desktop, memory for tests, small documents read once and written in turn, pictures decoded off the main thread; versioned documents of a game's own state with a canonical JSON text, a migration chain from every released version, fields an older build does not know kept, and golden-file checks.
